description: Direct read-only query surface over the ONE canonical corpus API (scripts/determinex_corpus_api.py, built earlier the same session -- search/stats/maturity_report/related_entries/find_superseded_claims/ask/timeline). Before this rung, that API was reachable only indirectly, through the two Learning Studio modes (explain_this_error, teach_me_the_concept) that happen to call ask() internally. This rung is WIRING, not invention: no new search/ranking/maturity logic was written. New command query_corpus wired end-to-end: backend_command_surface.py (_query_corpus, dispatching to ask()/maturity_report()/timeline() by mode) -> _tauri_driver.py (corpus_query/corpus_mode args threaded through) -> ide_repair_bridge.rs #[tauri::command] -> lib.rs generate_handler! -> LearningStudioPanel.tsx (new 'Ask the corpus anything' free-text box, results + supersession warnings rendered inline). Deliberately excluded from UNIFIED_PRODUCT_READ_ONLY_COMMANDS (Python + Rust), same reasoning as generate_learning_studio_content and run_maintenance_bay_scan: real per-call computation (a fresh corpus load + token-overlap search), not a static view-model snapshot.
purpose: Let a human (or a future script) ask the corpus a direct question from the IDE, without having to route through Learning Studio's two canned modes or hand-write a Python one-liner.

ui_modes_wired.ask: wired 2026-07-16 (initial rung) -- free-text box in LearningStudioPanel
ui_modes_wired.maturity: wired 2026-07-16 (same-day follow-up) -- 'What's missing?' toggle in LearningStudioPanel, shows open_items + corpus stats + flywheel status
ui_modes_wired.timeline: NOT yet wired to any UI -- reachable via the command (tested), no panel surface yet
